title: UK retail sales, Great Britain — August 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the print that fixes half of the September print's arithmetic
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/retailsalesgreatbritainaugust2026, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads verbatim 'Retail Sales; Great Britain: August 2026', '18 September 2026 7:00am' and 'This release is not yet published'. Corroborated by the July-2026 bulletin's own 'Next release: 18 September 2026' line, fetched the same day. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the adjacency sweep of the never-assessed initial research of uk-retail-sales-2026-10-23, 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-retail-sales-2026-10-23 LANE, 2026-09-10, eight days out and thirty-five days before its own event — outside the five-day corridor, and proposed anyway because it is the single largest mover of the proposer's arithmetic rather than a neighbour on the calendar. The September 2026 annual rate decomposes into a carry that is already determined (July 2026 index 103.8 against a September 2025 base of 102.7 = +1.07pp) plus two unknown monthly clears. THIS PRINT RESOLVES ONE OF THE TWO and simultaneously revises the other input: the ONS revises the prior months in every bulletin, and the two revisions this lane measured ran 0.3-0.6pp on a monthly rate (September 2025 published +0.5% m/m on 2025-10-24 and now reads +1.08% in the live J5EK index; June 2026 published +1.0% and now reads +0.68%). It also carries the only observed demand read for August, against which the BRC-KPMG monitor's total of +0.7% y/y for 2-29 August can be calibrated. SECOND REASON IT EARNS A SLOT: this calendar tracks the US retail print monthly across four entries (retail-sales-2026-09-16 through -12-16) and tracked no UK consumer-volume print at all until 2026-09-09; a single quarterly-looking UK entry misrepresents a monthly series whose publisher has issued ten consecutive monthly bulletins, every one on a Friday 18-27 days after its reference month ended. NAME COLLISION WORTH ONE SENTENCE IN ANY RECAP: retail-sales-2026-09-16 is the US Census advance print two days earlier, tiered high; this is Great Britain, a different publisher and a different concept (GB volumes, seasonally adjusted, versus US nominal receipts). Expected LOW on the same measured grounds as every UK sibling: symbols: [], no UK-listed name in this book, no sterling- or rates-keyed house playbook. Estimate widens caution only.
